sentences.text:
Smt. Sunanda vs The State Of Telangana, on 12 June, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.14446 Of 2017
Order:

entities.text: Sunanda vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a Writ, Order or Direction, more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the Respondents in arbitrarily digging up and interfering with the petitioners' patta lands i.e., Sy.Nos.71/A and 71/EE to its extent Ac.2-58 and 1-55 cents respectively situated at Goplapoor Village of Devarkadra Mandal, Mahaboobnagar District, without any notice nor opportunity pursuant allegedly to Memo No.AEE G1/DEE-II/General/1/2015, dated 07.12.2016 passed by t h e R e s p o n d e n t N o . 2 h e r e i n p u r s u a n t t o R e f e r e n c e Lr.No.2/PL/R&B/DCE/EE/DEE(4)/ AEE2/2016, dated 30.11.2016 of Engineer in Chief (R&B), State Roads and CRN, Hyderabad, thereby destroying the Red Gram crop (Kandi Pappu) as illegal, arbitrary, against the principles of natural justice,
Article 300-A of the Constitution of India and to pass..."

2. Heard Learned Counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development appearing for the respondents and perused the entire material on record.
SK,J 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that at the time of admission, on 21.04.2017 this Court granted interim order by directing the respondents not to meddle with the private property of the petitioners and if any private property of the petitioners is required for public purpose, it is open for them to proceed in accordance with law.
4.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development basing on the counter submits that the respondents have stopped the work and as per the norms of Roads and Buildings (NH-167) Department, the respondents are laying pipeline from the edge of the boundary and at a distance of 15m width from the center line, treating it as R&B road.
The work of laying pipeline will be taken up according to the level of land to have free flow of water through the pipeline and laying of pipeline is not taken up through the agricultural lands.

In view of the submission made by both sides, the writ petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioners in the subject property, without following due process of law.

If the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioners, they Smt. Sunanda vs The State Of Telangana, on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166409307/
1 have to follow the procedure under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
